title: Save and preview inert typed debug command recipes
changes: Add console and debug-command recipe save/preview for ordered typed actions, pinned to the selected session manifest and its declared ROM/runtime hashes; no action is dispatched.

Bound recipe names, file count, action count and explicit step frames; reject nested recipes, retry, cancellation, unbounded resume and overwriting an existing recipe. Add discoverable command hints and operation descriptors.
validation: Windows GNU build and 19 focused Wine tests passed for recipe authoring, pin mismatch, malformed/unbounded input, existing command parser and completion, and operation contracts; the menu atlas inventory check passed.

A synthetic session without ROM or control mailbox passed save and preview through the Windows executable under Wine, with identical typed ordered actions and duplicate-name refusal; successful scratch was removed.
limitations: These files are inert and the Scripts and tools selector does not yet accept them. Execution, enforcement of total runtime limits, assertions, cancellation, checkpoint, safe resume and short/interrupted end-to-end recipes remain open. Manifest pins are compared as declared, not independently rehashed. Native Windows and interactive console GUI were not tested.
